general_feeling: kendim bir kaç gün içerisinde varlığına alıştım aletin, fakat çevremdeki insanlara sürekli olarak ki şuan yaşadıgımız tehlikeli ve güvensizlik ortamında onların özel alanlarını ve yaşamlarını ihlal edilmiş şekilde rahatsız etmek beni çok üzdü.
challenges: yemek yerken eğilemiyordum alet çok ağır.  kolye varken rahat hareket edemiyorum hasar almaya çok musait.  bilekligin ipinin malzemesi kalitesiz tenimi çok rahatsız etti.  insanalara kendimi açıklamaktan yoruldum.    insanlardan kaçar oldum, az insan olan sokakları tercih ettim, mumkun oldugunca az kisiyle iletisime gectim.     yemek yerken, yuzumu yikarken tek elimle surekli diger aletler duslesin diye efor harcadim
act_impact: sosyallik, hareket kabiliyeti, hayatima duzen geldi surekli anket doldururken vaktin degerini anladim
beh_adapt: yere bakarak yuruyorum, insanlara bakmamaya calisiyorum, duzenli olarak telefona bakmam gerekiyor, hafizam gelisti
social: evet hep olumsuz tepkilerle karsilastim, deneyi aciklasam bile kabul edilmedi veya yadirgandim, garipsendim, insanlari rahatsiz ettim, kendim rahatsiz oldum
general_feeling_english: I got used to its presence myself within a few days, but constantly disturbing the people around me, especially in the dangerous and insecure environment we currently live in, by violating their privacy and lives, made me very upset.
challenges_english: I couldn't bend down while eating because the device is very heavy. I can't move comfortably while wearing the necklace, it is very prone to damage. The material of the wristband's string is poor quality, it irritated my skin a lot. I got tired of explaining myself to people. I started avoiding people, preferred streets with fewer people, and tried to interact with as few people as possible. While eating and washing my face, I constantly had to use one hand to prevent the other devices from falling.
act_impact_english: Sociality, mobility. My life became more organized, and I realized the value of time while filling out the questionnaires regularly.
beh_adapt_english: I walk looking down, try not to look at people, have to check my phone regularly, and my memory improved.
social_english: Yes, I always encountered negative reactions. Even when I explained the experiment, it wasn't accepted or it was found strange, I was seen as odd, I disturbed people, and I became uncomfortable myself.
improvements_english: If possible, please make it not resemble a camera. Thank you.
